page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg9i.2xlarge is a high clock speed virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It is equipped with 8 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs driven by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor operating at a base frequency of 3.4 GHz. The instance features 32.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a standard 1:4 ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

The instance provides an 8 Gbps baseline network bandwidth for external and internal data transit. It includes zero dedicated local storage drives, requiring administrators to attach remote block storage volumes for persistent data and operating system deployments. No discrete GPU hardware accelerators or complimentary public IPv4 addresses are provisioned with this configuration.

With dedicated high-frequency cores and a balanced allocation of memory, ecs.hfg9i.2xlarge targets processing pipelines requiring high per-core execution speeds alongside steady memory capacity. The instance profile is suited for compute-heavy production services, such as enterprise web serving, distributed application nodes, batch processing, and continuous integration and continuous deployment pipelines.
